# Burrmill

> SQL over sealed Parquet segments, in DuckDB's dialect, with exact integer arithmetic that refuses rather than wraps. A Rust library on DataFusion; the engine nuthatch embeds, and the one the browser demo runs in a tab.

Write DuckDB SQL, but not all of it: some forms are refused by name and some fail as syntax errors. Read the refused table before generating a statement.

- [The SQL surface](docs/sql.md): what `Engine::sql` admits, and the table of what it refuses (`PIVOT`, `UNPIVOT`, `ASOF JOIN`, `GLOB`, `strptime`, `median` over DECIMAL, `COLUMNS` and others) with what to write instead
- [The browser tab](docs/browser.md): the engine in a page, and what goes to a model
- [README](README.md): what the engine is, what it does not do, and where it loses to DuckDB

Segment files are read as `<table>-<hash>.parquet`; the text before the last hyphen is the table name.
